reader_summary.headline: In a world ravaged by late fees and lack of rewinding.
reader_summary.overview: In a world ravaged by late fees and lack of rewinding, one man two men from a sleepy California beach town make a stand against tyranny. But as always there is much more to the story than that! We dive into the fascinating, true, and oft-untold history of Netflix in our first two-part special on Acquired.

key_points.text: In a world ravaged by late fees and lack of rewinding.
Part 1 covers Netflix’s original DVD rental business from founding to 2009.
Sponsors: Legora: Vanta: ServiceNow: Statsig: More Acquired!
